product_one_liner.value: Forwood Safety provides safety and critical-risk-management software that helps companies in high-risk industries such as mining, construction and utilities prevent workplace fatalities and serious injuries.
product_one_liner.notes: Macquarie identifies the safety-software product and its mining, construction and utilities customers; Forwood describes its critical-risk-management solution as eliminating fatalities and serious injuries. Sources: https://www.macquarie.com/us/en/insights/investing-in-workplace-fatality-prevention-software.html and https://forwoodsafety.com/solutions.
